checks.output: The first controller obtained typed status and disconnected. The runner and workload stayed alive; a later connection resolved the same opaque host ID, runner PID and two-descendant tree.

checks.output: The final run and ten repeated regression runs left no runner, workload, grandchild, Unix socket or temporary directory; cleanup_fallbacks stayed empty. Exceptional cleanup is bounded to the recorded runner session and workload process group.
